meta.title: Services: audits, training and QMS consulting
meta.description: Internal, supplier and GMP audits, training and QMS consulting to ISO 9001, ISO 13485, ISO 19011 and GMP for medical device and pharma companies. With fixed scope, duration and deliverable.

head.title: Audits, training and consulting to ISO 9001, ISO 13485, ISO 19011 and GMP
head.lead: Clearly defined services with fixed scope, duration and deliverable.

audits.label: Audits
audits.title: Audits following the ISO 19011 method
audits.intro: Every audit is planned, risk-based and documented so that it can be traced.

internal.title: Internal audit
internal.text: Independent review of your quality management system, as required by the standard.

supplier.title: Supplier audit
supplier.text: Evaluation of critical suppliers and contract manufacturers on your behalf.

mock.title: Mock audit
mock.text: Rehearsal audit before certification, recertification or a notified body visit.

gmp.title: GMP audit
gmp.text: Audit of manufacturing, quality control and documentation in pharma.

training.label: Training
training.title: Training adapted to your processes
training.intro: As in-house training at your site or live online.

consulting.label: Consulting
consulting.title: Consulting for your quality management system
consulting.intro: From gap analysis to taking on the role of management representative. A system I have consulted on, I do not audit myself.

managementRep.title: External management representative
managementRep.text: Taking on the role per ISO 13485 clause 5.5.2, or as quality manager in an ISO 9001 system. Ideal when the position is vacant or the team is too small for its own role.

specs.deliverable: Management review and reporting to top management

gapAnalysis.title: Gap analysis
gapAnalysis.text: Comparison of your quality system with the requirements of the standard.

specs.deliverable: Gap report with prioritised action plan

qmsSetup.title: Setting up and developing your QMS
qmsSetup.text: Processes, procedures and documentation that fit your company and hold up in an audit.

certification.title: Certification support
certification.text: Support from planning to the certification audit, including handling of findings.

custom.title: Your topic is not listed?
custom.text: Audits, training and consulting can also be tailored to your company: further regulations, combined formats or individual processes.
